title: Housing Pressure & Urban Transformation
goal: Trace urban transformation and housing pressure with verbs of change
grammar: volverse, quedarse, convertirse en and hacerse in urban analysis

items: I can distinguish *volverse*, *quedarse*, *convertirse en* and *hacerse* for urban and market shifts.
I can describe resulting states like *quedarse despoblado* and *quedarse sin vivienda* accurately.
I can use vocabulary for tenants, evictions, property speculation and the housing market.
